svg.title: Blueprint BP-03, the live check. 1 Your site address. 2 Gather the home page and up to 40 same-site JavaScript files. 3 Stranger checks: keys in served code, downloadable .env and .git files, HTTPS and headers, source maps. With --mine: 4 find the Supabase or Firebase address and public key in your own pages, never a secret key. 5 Ask each table for one row as a stranger: open, refused or empty. With --two-users: 6 log in as test accounts A and B, find B's rows, ask for them as A, then the other way round, and list each other's storage folders. Reads only, writes are not tested. 7 Report with database, between customers and notes sections, counts and column names only.
